rv.q: Potent drama giving a voice to British-Pakistani women caught up in a scandal

Hussain compresses an awful lot of debating points into a small space. It’s not at all easy to follow all the references to all the offstage players in the local controversy. And the moment Jade blithely announces that she has a book deal strikes a melodramatic note (as does the scene where Zara tries to hide from her when she pays another visit).
this family drama... is powerful and courageous
Expendable is well-written, brilliantly staged and fantastically acted, I felt like it could go much further than it does.
